title: Little Tokyo Farmers' Market
address: 244 S. San Pedro St, Los Angeles, CA 90012
description: Weekly Saturday market run by JACCC and Food Access LA with local produce, SNAP/EBT accepted, plus nutrition and composting tips. Remaining 2026 Saturdays: Nov 21 and 28, Dec 5, 12, 19 and 26.
recurring: every Saturday (2026 season listed through Dec 26)

title: Little Tokyo Breakfast Club
address: 244 S. San Pedro St, Los Angeles, CA 90012
description: A monthly morning meetup over a home-cooked Japanese breakfast in the garden, with community storytelling and guest speakers. Check-in opens at 8:00.

title: Sashiko Mending Workshop with Sanae Suzuki
address: 244 S. San Pedro St, 5th Floor, Los Angeles, CA 90012
description: Hands-on class using Japanese sashiko stitching for visible mending on a garment you bring. Some sashiko or hand-sewing experience is recommended.

title: Go Little Tokyo Small Business Saturday Pop-up
description: Go Little Tokyo merch pop-up with a prize wheel spin for anyone showing a same-day receipt from a Little Tokyo small business.

title: Go Little Tokyo Holiday Lucky Draw
description: Shop or dine at Little Tokyo small businesses and submit receipts for a chance to win a bundle of local merchandise and gift cards.

title: Museum Store Sunday at JANM
venue: Japanese American National Museum, Democracy Center
address: 100 N. Central Ave, Los Angeles, CA 90012
description: JANM Store pop-up with a trunk show of local jewelry and wearable art; non-members get 10% off eligible items.

title: Imagine Little Tokyo Writing Workshop with D.K. Furutani
address: 100 N. Central Ave, Los Angeles, CA 90012
description: Free writing workshop to help you draft a fiction entry set in Little Tokyo for the 2027 Imagine Little Tokyo Short Story Contest. Registration required.

title: Iconic Voices: Art Hansen's Favorite Oral Histories
venue: Japanese American National Museum, Democracy Center
address: 100 N. Central Ave, Los Angeles, CA 90012
description: Actors perform dramatized readings of oral histories collected by the late historian Art Hansen, telling Japanese American stories from WWII and after.

title: The Okinawan Way: Bokashi Composting Workshop
address: 123 S. Hewitt St, Los Angeles, CA 90012
description: Beginner class on bokashi, an Okinawan fermentation method that composts all kitchen scraps. Presented with Sustainable Little Tokyo.
price: $15 + $1.50 fee (DIY bokashi bag included); optional kits $35

title: Auntie Kristina's Guide to Asian American Activism: Audiobook Launch
venue: Japanese American National Museum, Democracy Center
address: 100 N. Central Ave, Los Angeles, CA 90012
description: Kristina Wong and her co-authors celebrate the audiobook release with all-ages storytelling, performance and a book signing.
price: $5 adults; free for youth and JANM members

title: Tuesday Night Cafe
venue: Aratani Courtyard, Union Center for the Arts
address: 120 Judge John Aiso St, Los Angeles, CA 90012
description: Long-running free Asian American open mic and performance series with music, poetry and spoken word. A city culture calendar lists Dec 1 and Dec 15, 2026, but the organizer's own page says the season runs April through October, so check before going.

title: Oshogatsu in Little Tokyo (New Year's Day)
venue: Weller Court and Japanese Village Plaza
address: Weller Court, 123 Astronaut Ellison S Onozuka St; Japanese Village Plaza, 335 E 2nd St
description: Japanese Chamber of Commerce of Southern California's New Year's Day festival with stage performances, ondo dancing and Shinto New Year blessings. In 2026 it ran roughly 10:50-15:40 at Weller Court and 12:30-16:10 at the plaza.

title: 10th Annual Cultural Ikebana Exhibition
address: 244 S. San Pedro St, Lobby, Los Angeles, CA 90012
description: New Year flower-arranging show by teachers from the Ikenobo, Sogetsu and Ohara schools. The Jan 10 opening at 11:00 includes a kagami biraki ceremony with sweet amazake.

title: Soul Train: A New Year's Dance Party & Shinnenkai
address: 815 E. 1st St, Los Angeles, CA 90012
description: Friends of JACCC benefit with dinner, a New Year toast, line dancing and live music from Kokoro & Friends. Dancing starts at 19:30.

title: JANM Oshogatsu Family Festival
address: 244 S. San Pedro St, Los Angeles, CA 90012
description: Free all-ages New Year festival with mochitsuki (rice pounding) by taiko groups, crafts, a stamp rally and performances. The 2026 edition was Jan 11 and 2025 was Jan 5; Jan 10, 2027 is only an estimate.
recurring: annual, a Sunday in early-to-mid January

title: JANM Reopening: Renovated Pavilion
address: 100 N. Central Ave, Los Angeles, CA 90012
description: The museum's main pavilion reopens after a two-year renovation that added a new glass entrance and reworked the galleries.

title: Pictures of Belonging: Miki Hayakawa, Hisako Hibi, and Miné Okubo
address: 100 N. Central Ave, Los Angeles, CA 90012
description: JANM's first show in the reopened pavilion: 80+ paintings and drawings by three Japanese American women artists, covering eight decades. Opening date confirmed; the Aug 29 end date comes from an ArtRabbit listing.

title: Kristina Wong: #FoodBankInfluencer
venue: East West Players, David Henry Hwang Theater (Union Center for the Arts)
address: 120 Judge John Aiso St, Los Angeles, CA 90012
description: Kristina Wong's comic musical about the US emergency food system, based on her own volunteering. Free groceries are given out after every show. Feb 18 is a preview and Feb 19 is opening night.

title: Day of Remembrance (Los Angeles)
venue: Little Tokyo (2026: Los Angeles Hompa Hongwanji Buddhist Temple)
address: 815 E. 1st St, Los Angeles, CA 90012 (2026 venue)
description: Community event marking Executive Order 9066 (Feb 19, 1942), which led to the WWII incarceration of Japanese Americans. In 2026 it was held Saturday, Feb 21; the 2027 date and venue have not been announced.

title: Hiroshi Yoshimura: Sound of Place, Place of Sound
address: 244 S. San Pedro St, Lobby, Los Angeles, CA 90012
description: Exhibition on Japanese environmental-music pioneer Hiroshi Yoshimura, with scores, archival material, photos and a hi-fi listening installation. Related Wild Up concerts are Mar 19-20 at REDCAT, outside Little Tokyo.

title: Finding Our Okinawan Roots (Discover Nikkei)
description: Free virtual talk on tracing Okinawan family history, with personal stories and an introduction to the Okinawa Prefectural Library's genealogy service. Registration had not opened yet.

title: Delicious Little Tokyo
venue: Little Tokyo Metro Station Plaza (2026 hub)
description: Spring food and culture festival with J-Town Bingo, community booths and ticketed food history walking tours. The 2026 edition was Saturday, Apr 18; the 2027 date is an estimate.

title: VC FilmFest: Los Angeles Asian Pacific Film Festival
description: Visual Communications' Academy Award-qualifying Asian Pacific film festival. The 2026 edition ran Apr 29-May 3; 2027 dates have not been announced, and not every screening is in Little Tokyo.
recurring: annual, late April to early May

title: Nishi Hongwanji Obon Carnival
venue: Los Angeles Hompa Hongwanji Buddhist Temple (Nishi)
address: 815 E. 1st St, Los Angeles, CA 90012
description: Temple summer festival with bon odori folk dancing, food and games. The 2026 edition was Jul 11 (15:00-21:00) and Jul 12 (15:00-20:30).

title: Higashi Honganji Obon Festival
address: 505 E. 3rd St, Los Angeles, CA 90013
description: Temple Obon with bon odori dancing, food booths and performances. The 2026 edition ran Jul 25-26, 13:00-21:00.

title: Zenshuji Obon Carnival
address: 123 S. Hewitt St, Los Angeles, CA 90012
description: Long-running Zen temple carnival with food, games and Obon services. The 2026 (68th) edition ran Jul 25-26, 12:00-19:00.

title: Nisei Week Japanese Festival
description: Little Tokyo's biggest festival and one of the oldest ethnic festivals in the US, with a parade, ondo dancing, food and cultural shows over two weekends. The 2026 (84th) edition ran Aug 15-23; 2027 dates are an estimate.

title: L.A. Tanabata Festival
address: 244 S. San Pedro St, Los Angeles, CA 90012
description: Display of colorful hand-made tanabata streamers (kazari) by local groups, plus giant kazari sent from Sendai, held during Nisei Week. The 2026 edition ran Aug 15-23.

title: Haunted Little Tokyo
description: Month of Halloween programming from the Little Tokyo Community Council, including ghost tours and a 21+ Halloween block party. In 2026 the block party was Oct 31 and tours sold out.
